svg.text: 29 x 30 mm, same size and mounting holes as the CyberBrick receiver shield; the ESP32-S3-Zero sits in the middle
I2S to the amplifier (through 33 Ohm resistors)
hop on the bottom layer (under the S trace)
via to the 5 V rail (R5 pull-up); the other vias go to the ground plane
Bottom side: GND plane, 7 test pads in the lower margin (5V, 3V3, GND, IO1, BCLK, LRC, DIN)
Hole spacing 23.0 x 24.0 mm from the CAD model of a CyberBrick receiver test housing (matches the manufacturer's image).
Hole diameter 2.7 mm from the manufacturer's image. Verify both with calipers on the real receiver.
A screw head of 4.5 mm leaves only 0.26 mm to the corner of the Zero; use a low or countersunk head.
